name: Remote MCP Server Authless
description: A template for deploying a remote Model Context Protocol server on Cloudflare Workers without authentication. It enables users to build custom tools and expose them to remote clients like Claude Desktop and the Cloudflare AI Playground using Server-Sent Events (SSE).
